flags.flag: VACUITY? checked, none: the non-definability conjunct would be trivial if no program could ever accept; this one can (e.g. one that sets halt and accept at once defines the trivial query).
flags.why: The model is not degenerate, and it defines more than the constant queries the first reader exhibited. Take a one-step program with body parallel(update halt := ordinal 1, update accept := not(equal(comprehend x ∈ atoms | input Ed x x . x, ordinal 0))). From the initial store, halt reads ∅ ≠ {∅}, so the step fires. The two updates hit different locations, so State.Consistent holds. run 1 halts and accepts iff some a has Ed a a, a non-constant, isomorphism-invariant query. It runs in time 1, and its space is linear in |A|: the occurring set is the hereditary closure of the atoms, allAtoms, ∅, {∅} and one subset of the atoms. So EvaluationDefinable is a non-trivial class, and ¬ EvaluationDefinable(query) is a real separation, not a vacuous one. Lane K has not run ChoicelessPolynomialTime.

flags.flag: JUNK? (low): ∫⁻ of a non-measurable integrand is a lower integral; s ↦ Φ*(X + sqrt(s) S) is monotone in s, so it is measurable
flags.why: The first reader's argument holds. f(s) = Φ*(X + √s S) is antitone in s, for three reasons. First, Φ* here depends only on the joint *-distribution: the conjugate-system identities and polynomialL2 are fixed by the moments under a faithful tracial vector. Second, for t > s, X + √t S has the distribution of (X + √s S) + √(t−s) S′, with S′ a free semicircular family free from (X, S): FreeStandardNoise makes the S i semicircular and free from each other and from X. Third, Voiculescu's inequality Φ*(Y + Z) ≤ Φ*(Y) for Y, Z free gives f(t) ≤ f(s). For s ≤ 0, √s = 0 and f(s) = Φ*(X) ≥ f(t). An antitone map ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ is measurable, and b is continuous, so b − f and f − b are measurable and both lintegrals are true integrals, not lower integrals. This rests on the standard free-probability inequality, not on anything run.
